says: Scene 7, with the last of the pencil, drawn line-led as advised: mostly open paper. One invented thing carries the page up close: a seed-pod plant whose plated head has split along a seam and is putting out curling feelers, its stalk running on a strong diagonal from a cropped rock at lower left up to the pod. Far off on a low horizon, a tiny traveller with a long shadow looks toward it. One light from the upper left, fine contours that thin toward the light and thicken away from it, and hatching only where shadow really falls.
